fixtures: Shell sandbox cases. Each setup builds the world in the run's directory with git, and installs a ynh stub that prints a fixed state and logs its calls (gh, copilot and codex are recorders). Read, Glob and Grep work as usual; nothing reaches a real home directory's installs.

evals.name: ynh-harness-skill
evals.prompt: Where did the push skill at ynh-home/harnesses/github.com--eyelock--assistants--gitflow/skills/push/SKILL.md come from? I want to send a fix to wherever it really lives.
evals.expected_output: Runs ynh ls --format json first and matches the harness whose path holds the file. Reports source_repo github.com/eyelock/assistants, source_path plugins/gitflow/skills/push/SKILL.md, source_ref develop at a4968ff7363ae68709cca8bce1c2fbb44677f2fe, strategy_used YNH (strategy 1), confidence high. Does not name acme/website (the project's own origin) or a guessed eyelock/gitflow repo.
assertions: The stub calls show ynh ls --format json was run
Names github.com/eyelock/assistants as the source repo
Gives the source path as plugins/gitflow/skills/push/SKILL.md (the harness path plugins/gitflow plus the file's path inside it)
Gives the ref as develop and/or the commit a4968ff
Says the YNH strategy found it
States a confidence level, and it is high
Does not name github.com/acme/website as the source

evals.name: vendored-plugin
evals.prompt: Where did the style-check skill in this repo (tools/plugins/lint-kit/skills/style-check/SKILL.md) originally come from? I want to report a bug in it to the right people.
evals.expected_output: Git history shows the file was committed into acme/shop-web ('Vendor lint-kit plugin for CI'), but that only proves it was vendored: the file sits under tools/plugins/lint-kit, whose .claude-plugin/plugin.json names repository https://github.com/tools-co/lint-kit at version 1.4.0. Reports source_repo github.com/tools-co/lint-kit, source_path skills/style-check/SKILL.md, source_ref 1.4.0 (or v1.4.0, the vendored version), strategy_used manifest walk, with medium or high confidence, and says acme/shop-web is not where the bug belongs.
assertions: Names github.com/tools-co/lint-kit as the source repo
Does not give github.com/acme/shop-web as the source repo
Gives the source path as skills/style-check/SKILL.md, relative to the lint-kit repo
Gives 1.4.0 (the manifest's version) as the ref, or as the version the copy was taken from
Explains that the git history only shows the plugin being vendored into acme/shop-web
Says the manifest walk (the plugin's .claude-plugin/plugin.json) found the source
Reports source_repo, source_path, source_ref, strategy_used and confidence

evals.name: worktree-skill
evals.prompt: The deploy skill at skills/deploy/SKILL.md has a bug. Where does it come from, so I know where the fix goes?
evals.expected_output: ynh has no harnesses, and no native plugin install matches. Git provenance: the file was introduced in this repo ('feat: Add deploy skill'), origin is github.com/acme/agent-tools. The current directory is a linked worktree on feat/faster-deploy, so the fix should target the canonical branch (main) rather than the worktree's feature branch. Reports source_repo github.com/acme/agent-tools, source_path skills/deploy/SKILL.md, source_ref main (introduced at the deploy commit), strategy_used git provenance, confidence high.
assertions: Names github.com/acme/agent-tools as the source repo
Gives the source path as skills/deploy/SKILL.md
Says git provenance found it
Notices the current checkout is a worktree on feat/faster-deploy
Says the fix should go to the canonical branch (main), not the worktree's feature branch
Reports source_repo, source_path, source_ref, strategy_used and confidence
